scope: Read-only scientific closeout review of summary, 01, STATUS and the unexecuted next-stage protocol; distinct from independent arithmetic recomputation

findings.issue: Original video was called the statistical independent unit without acknowledging cross-source author/program/session dependence
findings.resolution: Summary and temporal report now describe source as the resampling unit and state the approximate independence/exchangeability assumption and unexcluded session dependence

findings.issue: Six portrait and six landscape sources do not alone freeze target ratio or guarantee x/y free-axis coverage
findings.resolution: Unexecuted next-stage protocol freezes actual W/H, landscape to 9:16 and portrait to 16:9 target ratios, and computed six-x/six-y coverage before annotation; summary/spatial protocol text synchronized

other_result: No additional contradiction in principal reported numbers or attribution found in this scoped review; this is not independent new-source confirmation
principal_investigator_addendum: Main summary explicitly distinguishes public actual-PTS coverage from R25 official metadata-FPS sampling and identifies existing B3 129-candidate utility learning as inherited rather than a new algorithm
